text:
Mira Patel: Heads up — staged cutover to eu-west-2 is getting stuck on step 2. Terraform apply fails creating gpu-nodegroup: subnet IP exhaustion. GitOps keeps reconciling and the canary weight keeps flipping back.
Sam Wu: Yep seeing it too. Cluster-autoscaler pods CrashLoopBackOff after the new taint landed. nginx probe failing 502 on the canary service.
Jonathan Reed: Paste the TF error?
Mira Patel: `Error: could not allocate IPs: requested 50, available 32 in subnet subnet-abc123`
Anya Singh: Ops-bot just alerted: spot capacity in eu-west-2 is tight; fallback to on-demand increased cost by ~42% last hour. :grimacing:
deploy-bot: GitOps reconciler applied commit abc123 — canary-weight=0 -> 100 -> 0 (auto-revert due to failed health checks)
Sam Wu: The reconciler loop is the rough part — it will keep flipping weights while Terraform is failing to bring nodes up. We should avoid thrashing the production route.
Jonathan Reed: Quick mitigation proposal: 1) pause GitOps sync for the canary service 2) run a manual `terraform apply` bumping `subnet_ip_quota` / add a /26 to the AZ or attach a new subnet 3) temporarily scale nodegroup min=3 and set max surge to 0 so the autoscaler doesn't evict.
Mira Patel: I can pause the argocd app now. Which argocd app name? `apps/service-canary-eu`?
Sam Wu: Yes that's the one. Pause and hold traffic at current weight (don't let it drop to 0). Then we do manual infra changes.
Anya Singh: From cost side, if we add a new subnet it might increase infra spend but avoids a rollback. Ops: we should prefer adding a small /26 vs switching to on-demand at scale.
Mira Patel: Paused argocd for apps/service-canary-eu — status: suspended. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: argocd: app "service-canary-eu" has been suspended by Mira Patel (reason: manual intervention for subnet quotas).
Jonathan Reed: I'm going to open a quick terraform change: add `extra_subnets = ["10.12.8.0/26"]` and run plan/apply in the eu-west-2 workspace. Will annotate the PR so GitOps won't pick it up until we re-enable.
Sam Wu: Once TF is applied, please `kubectl get nodes -o wide` and confirm GPU nodes join and are Ready. Also check cluster-autoscaler logs for scale-up errors: `kubectl -n kube-system logs deployment/cluster-autoscaler`
Mira Patel: Noted. I'll hold traffic at 30% canary, don't abort the cutover. If health checks stay flaky for >15m we should rollback manually to previous release tag.
Anya Singh: Also add a temporary probe tweak: extend readiness probe initialDelaySeconds from 5 -> 20 for the canary to avoid transient 502s during warmup. We'll revert after stable.
Jonathan Reed: Applying TF now. Running: `terraform workspace select eu-west-2 && terraform apply -var='extra_subnets=["10.12.8.0/26"]' -auto-approve`
ops-bot: Cost alert: projected cost increase +8% if we apply extra_subnets and bump on-demand fallback. Manual approval required for budget owners.
Mira Patel: I'll ping FinOps in #finance to approve the temporary band-aid.
Sam Wu: If TF apply succeeds and nodes are Ready, I'll scale the nodegroup to desired=3 and set the taint to accept GPU workloads. Then we can resume argocd and resume gradual traffic ramp at 10% increments every 5m.
Mira Patel: Thanks — I'll monitor the canary dashboards (latency, error rate, cost burn) and report back.
Jonathan Reed: TF apply finished: added subnet, AWS reports new subnets created. Spinning up nodes now.
Sam Wu: Nodes are joining, `kubectl get nodes` shows 3 new gpu nodes Ready. Cluster-autoscaler logs show scale-up completed.
deploy-bot: GitOps reconciler detected drift (argocd app suspended) — no automatic sync performed.
Mira Patel: Re-enabling argocd sync in 10m once health metrics look stable.
Anya Singh: Cost owners approved temporary subnet addition. :thumbsup:
Mira Patel: Re-enabled argocd sync. Resuming traffic ramp: 30% -> 50% now.
Sam Wu: Canaries passing so far, no new 502s. Gradual ramp to 100% on the next window per runbook.
Jonathan Reed: Follow-up todo: add a guard in Terraform to fail fast if subnet IPs < threshold and a Doc PR for subnet quota checks in the cutover runbook.
Mira Patel: Agreed. I'll file the runbook PR and link it here. Close the thread once runbook merged. :white_check_mark:
